# G Studio (1069.com.hk)

> G Studio is a Hong Kong one-person full-stack studio by Vita Lam (林瀚海) under G Entertainment Limited: custom websites, business systems, data dashboards, and ICCC® AI Business Automation with the patent-pending AI Logic Firewall (the AI only says what the owner approved). Bilingual 繁體中文/English. Contact: WhatsApp +852 6979 8969 · vita.lam@icloud.com.

## Pricing (fixed, transparent, HKD)
- Standard prices with **70% off for eligible businesses**: start-ups (BR/statements), little-or-no-profit companies (last tax filing), NGOs (official document), and businesses advancing social rights (mission note). Proof required; monthly slots capped.
- Website Core: eligible HK$3,840 (standard HK$12,800) — 5 pages, bilingual, SEO-optimized, AI-ready.
- ICCC® AI Business Automation + AI firewall: eligible HK$12,000 (standard HK$40,000), no monthly fees.
- Data integration & dashboard: eligible HK$7,800 (standard HK$26,000).
- Brand visual & copywriting: eligible from HK$2,790.
- SiteCare+ (flat for all): 1yr HK$3,000 / 2yr HK$5,000 — hosting, SSL, backups, monitoring, unlimited revisions at HK$140/hr; free bookkeeping help for young companies.
- Payment: 50% deposit, 50% on delivery; 100% refundable if unsatisfied (terms apply). Full source-code handover — everything belongs to the client.

## Free with every plan
Business-strategy advisory (ex-SFC background), legal & business document help, business-policy peer review (HKCGI/AML-CFT certified) — peer experience sharing, not formal legal/financial advice.
